The '''Sphere of Production and Logistics''', also known as the '''Pyramid of Production and Logistics''', was one of twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Headed by a [[Dark Council]]or, the Sphere oversaw the [[Ministry of Logistics]]. The [[Minister of Logistics]] reported directly to the [[Dark Council]]or at the head of the Sphere&mdash;a position filled by [[Darth Vowrawn]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

After the Empire's defeat at the hand of the [[Eternal Empire]], the sphere was combined with the [[Sphere of Laws and Justice]] into the [[Sphere of Civil Administration]] by Empress [[Darth Acina]].<ref name="SOTG" />
